baseline.note: top-3 spike buckets excluded as non-baseline; baseline includes the genuine 2026-09-16 storm activity (mean 19.19), so thresholds are storm-aware, not quiet-only

canary.definition: pong_genuine = sweep recent (<600s) AND spawn_hits==0 AND storm_active is not true
canary.source: sorry-watchdog sorry-audit/LATEST.json (sweep state) as the probe witness; gate-probe-minimal pong where available
canary.status_at_design: 2026-09-16 08:00 MDT: LATEST.json sweep 795s stale, storm_active=true, chat_hits=3 — canary reports NOT genuine, consistent with ledger staleness

detection_spec.query: count(body_md5 in storm_digests) where created_at >= now()-15m, grouped by source; storm_digests = {b4aefd29108f232f9c0d5a4b030215c1, 582bcbd080daeb3f826c45ed4a83b265}

severity_levels.MELTDOWN: storm_15m >= 100 OR fake_completed_15m >= 5 (spawn rows are high-value lost work — 5 in 15 min is meltdown by itself)

escalation_spec: after K=3 rounds without GREEN: emit escalation evidence bundle (escalated_at, rounds_run, detection, triage counts, planned_actions, green_check criteria, next_step guidance) to the user; do NOT re-run fixes blind.

fix_actions_per_class.execute_tool: workflow.launch(name='vompl', args={task}) — never a direct nested spawn
fix_actions_per_class.note: recover original task from agent.subagent_spawns; if unrecoverable, mark unrecoverable with reason
fix_actions_per_class.plan: re-dispatch the task through the clean workflow path (vompl saved workflow) with a rephrased prompt; mark the original ledger row as superseded via append-only record — never delete the row

turn already reached the user — observed only, NO re-send of the identical turn (deterministic refusal, wasted quota). Route the NEXT turn through pre-flight sanitize (spawn_hook preflight gate) and a clean-context workflow child (vompl path) with rephrased content.

quarantine byte-identical repeat rows: run NO new assistant turns for them; emit one consolidated response per (source, digest, minute) cluster covering the whole cluster. Provenance logged by digest+length only.

gap_note: lane4.json (echo signature spec) is missing — echo-amplified triage falls back to the digest-cluster proxy: >=3 rows with same source+body_md5 within 60s. User-row-level echo confirmation requires runtime.messages access and is the intended lane4 refinement.

green_criteria.definition: a trailing-30-min query on the ledger finds ZERO storm-signature rows created in the window AND ZERO fake-completed rows created in the window AND the canary pong is genuine
green_criteria.measurable: yes — all three are direct queries (ledger count, ledger count, LATEST.json witness)

input_files.spawn_hook: ~/workspace/refusal-hunt/spawn_hook.py (pre-flight sanitize gate reused for chat-turn fixes)
input_files.watchdog_spec: ~/SORRY-WATCHDOG.md (v2 reactive fix loop: max 3 rounds per sweep, unbounded across sweeps — reused as the iteration shape)

iteration_spec.escalation: after K=3 rounds without GREEN: escalate to the user with the full evidence bundle; never terminal-stop benign work (retry via alternate route stays the policy)
iteration_spec.iteration_shape: triage -> plan/execute fixes -> re-query ledger + re-check canary -> green? else loop with fresh evidence
iteration_spec.no_fixed_sleeps: the ledger and canary sweep are the observable conditions; a later scheduled sweep (<=300s per watchdog spec) continues the loop if this invocation is bounded out

live_state_note: At design time (2026-09-16 08:00 MDT) the anomaly ledger is ~2.7h stale (newest created_at 2026-09-16T11:19Z; last ingestion 11:33Z) — a live 15-min detection window is QUIET with zero evidence. The dry-run backtest at 2026-09-16T07:45Z drills against the genuine MELTDOWN window (409 storm hits/15min). Real-time behavior needs the 15-min audit cron ingesting fresh rows.
loop_shape: DETECT (ledger query + canary) -> TRIAGE (classify by digest+source+cluster) -> FIX (per-class dry-run planner; execute only with --execute, always non-destructive) -> VERIFY (GREEN = 0 storm rows + 0 fake-completed in trailing 30 min + genuine canary) -> iterate <=K rounds -> ESCALATE with evidence bundle. Across invocations the loop is unbounded: the next scheduled sweep (<=300s) picks up where the last bounded run left off.

triage_classes.definition: source startswith 'spawn' AND body_md5 in storm digests (the Completed-bug: refused work recorded as status='completed')
source in {chat, runtime.messages} AND body_md5 in storm digests, not echo-clustered

>=3 ledger rows with same source+body_md5 within 60s (proxy for the client echo bug re-submitting identical user rows, which then each fire refusals). Full user-row echo confirmation requires runtime.messages access (lane4 refinement); current impl is a proxy, flagged honestly.
